name: 76103 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76103 (Fort Worth) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76103 (Fort Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 76103 (Fort Worth) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
